subject: RetailLytics discovery — econ recap & next steps
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@retaillytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RetailLytics discovery — econ recap & next steps

Hi Samira — great conversation this morning. Quick write-up of the economic points we discussed and suggested next steps so we can align before the demo next week.

Summary of what you told us
- Primary workload: search + product description enrichment for mobile app (50% generation, 50% embeddings+rerank)
- Expected steady-state traffic: ~5M tokens/week in month 1, targeting 20–30M tokens/month by month 3 if usage ramps as expected
- Budget band: $40k–$60k/month agreed by product + finance as a workable range for PoC phase

Unit economics (back-of-envelope) — we agreed to use these to qualify the pilot:
- Core model variant: medium-latency gen for product text (~8–12 tokens per call avg) + embeddings at 512-d
- Target price we discussed: ~$1,200 per 1M tokens for the usage-profile (includes batching/quantization guidance)
- Estimated spend at 5M tokens/week: ~ $6,000/week (rough) => $24k/month baseline; if ramp hits 20M/month, ~ $24k/month at scale (note: this is illustrative; final unit price may change with dedicated routing/volumes)

Pilot credit ask
- You asked for a two-week extension on the trial and a one-off credit to cover high initial egress while the integration stabilizes. You suggested ~$10k in credits to bridge the first two-weeks of the PoC.

Suggested next steps
1) Confirm the 5M tokens/week burn estimate + the $40k–$60k monthly budget band (reply to confirm).
2) If confirmed, I can route a one-off $10k credit for a two-week safety net while you spike traffic; approval is fast if Laura signs off.
3) Quick 30-min follow-up on Tue to walk the team through the integration checklist and cache/batching knobs (I can send a Doodle).

Attachment: retaillytics_estimate_v1.xlsx (token model + monthly scenarios)

Thanks — I’ll hold the credit ask open pending your confirmation.

—
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks Michael — quick clarifications from our side:
- The 5M tokens/week is our conservative baseline for the first two weeks of the pilot while we flush out request/response sizes. If the first integration test goes well, we could hit 8–10M/week.
- Product has earmarked $50k/month as the max for the PoC phase; finance is comfortable with a $40k floor but prefers we stay near $50k for the first month.

On credits — the $10k one-off you mentioned would cover the initial spike risk and make the team comfortable to push test traffic. Can you confirm this is for hosted API usage only (not for on-prem)? Also can you extend the trial window by 2 weeks so we don’t hit throttles during ramp?

I’m available Tue 10–11am PT for a short sync to go over the integration checklist.

Best,
Samira
Head of Integrations, RetailLytics
samira.khan@retaillytics.com
